why: Both describe the Dome Trail from Vista Point to the base of the dome and then the single ledge/chimney scramble up the south side, with an out-and-back return.

The FKT page follows the Whitney Portal, Ebersbacher Ledges, Boy Scout Lakes approach to the East Ridge and reverses it, matching our approach and descent; an independent report confirms that approach and ridge.
Piute Pass trail, cross-country to the Humphreys basin and up the northwest notch is the same line as the independent guide's southwest slope and northwest notch route.
The FKT page names the standard Keyhole Route from the Longs Peak Trailhead, matching the Boulder Field, Keyhole, Ledges, Trough, Narrows, Homestretch line described independently.
The FKT is an out-and-back on a worn trail then class 3 or easier upper slopes, consistent with the guide's standard East Ridge (the only other route is a rarely used west side).
Mountain Project's Cathedral Traverse from Lupine Meadows over Teewinot, Owen and the Grand Teton North Ridge with the Owen-Spalding descent matches ours and the FKT page links that same route.
Both start at Big Sandy, run Pingora through Warbonnet along the divide and finish down to Big Sandy Lake and the trail out.
Lupine Meadows, Garnet Canyon, Lower and Upper Saddles then Owen-Spalding to the summit and back matches the standard route.
